Othala — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᛟ
home family roots what you've inherited

Upright meaning

Othala is about home, family, and the things you carry from your past. It's asking you to think about where you come from — not just literally, but in terms of the patterns, values, and ways of being that got handed down to you.

Some of what you inherited is genuinely valuable — skills, perspectives, a sense of identity and belonging. Lean into those things.

But some of it might be old patterns that don't serve you anymore. Now's a good time to be honest about which is which — hold onto what's worth keeping, and consciously let go of what isn't.

Reversed meaning

Othala reversed can mean feeling disconnected from home, family, or where you came from — maybe there's tension with relatives, or you're carrying baggage from your upbringing that's holding you back rather than helping you.

It can also point to inheritance drama — money, property, or unfinished family business that needs sorting out. Or it might just be that unsettled feeling of not quite belonging anywhere right now.

Either way, it's worth taking an honest look at what you inherited and deciding what's actually still worth keeping. Some of it you get to let go of, and that's okay.
